description_expanded: 30A Monterey Place - Luxury Beachfront Condo in Seacrest Beach Favorite Features: Gulf-Front Private Beach Access Complimentary Beach Chairs (In-Season) Shared Pool Corner Unit Wake up to the sound of the waves and step straight onto the sand at 30A Monterey Place – a Gulf-front getaway in the private, gated community of Monterey Place in Seacrest Beach. With direct beach access, wide-open ocean views and room for up to 10 guests, it’s the perfect place to slow down, stretch out and soak up the best of 30A. Located just a short walk or bike ride from Alys and Rosemary, this quiet stretch of sand along Seacrest Beach offers all the charm and access without the crowds.  Inside, enjoy floor-to-ceiling Gulf views, an open-concept living area and fully-stocked kitchen for easy meals at home. Unwind on the spacious, corner balcony and fall asleep to the sound of the waves.  Whether it’s a family trip or beach week with friends, 30A Monterey Place is a relaxed, front-row seat to the Gulf – just far enough from the bustle to feel like your own slice of paradise.  Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. Private Balcony & Gulf Views. Bedroom 2: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 3: Queen Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Additional Arrangements: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed
